value: Donald Knuth is a highly influential American computer scientist and mathematician, widely regarded as the "father of the analysis of algorithms" and a recipient of the Turing Award. He is best known for his monumental multi-volume work, *The Art of Computer Programming*, which systematically developed formal mathematical techniques for the rigorous analysis of algorithm computational complexity. Beyond his theoretical contributions, Knuth also profoundly impacted practical computing by creating the TeX digital typesetting system and pioneering the concept of literate programming.
